one_line: Nvidia reports strong earnings amid leadership changes, OpenAI and Microsoft release new models, and Anthropic heads toward a major IPO.

themes.title: Nvidia reports strong earnings and leadership shifts
themes.text: Nvidia reported Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion and forecasted Q4 revenue of $130 billion, while facing ongoing leadership transitions, export control shifts under acting CEO Colette Kress, and upcoming congressional testimony for former CEO Jensen Huang.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify before US House committees on Dec 1

themes.title: OpenAI and Microsoft launch new models
themes.text: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with benchmark gains and lower pricing, and Microsoft unveiled six new models including MAI Code 2 and Flash on GitHub Copilot.

themes.title: Anthropic IPO brings massive startup windfalls
themes.text: Anthropic's upcoming IPO at an expected $1.4 trillion valuation is set to generate massive financial windfalls for its early backers and startup insiders.

themes.title: Major funding rounds and sovereign AI expansion
themes.text: Isomorphic Labs raised a $5 billion Series C for drug design, Genesis AI secured a $500 million Series A, and new sovereign AI partnerships and platforms emerged in Canada, Germany, and India.
